subject: Link to send email, to attach a pdf report of output data from a calculation

messages.author: ddb8912b211aebad
messages.subject: Link to send email, to attach a pdf report of output data from a calculation
parts:
Good morning.

I would like to do the following inside a shiny instance:

I have an app that does some computation and after some seconds, it finish. 

I would like to put a link in the same webpage when the computation finishes, so you can send by email a report of the results. And I'm thinking on how to accomplish it.

I would like to know two things:

1) How to make shiny open Outlook/Thunderbird to send an email to somebody, with a PDF of the records automatically attached. Maybe I'm asking too much.
2) In the app, I would generate the PDF with knitr. But.. how do I create it inside server.R? Where do I store it in order to be visible for the link "Send via email" to work?

Thank you

messages.subject: Re: Link to send email, to attach a pdf report of output data from a calculation
parts:
I have had good success using the mailR package (which I've tested on both gmail and MS Exchange/Outlook accounts)
(https://github.com/rpremraj/mailR)

What I do is have a button which creates a report then emails it, such as this example:

library(mailR)
library(knitr)

...

observeEvent(input$emailReport, {
  
  # 1) Generate the report to the working directory (or wherever you want)
  # Knit/Render your file here, or for a more basic example:
  pdf("report.pdf")
  plot(mtcars$mpg, mtcars$hp)
  dev.off()

  # 2) Email the report
  from <- [put your Outlook email acccount here]
  to <- c("per...@example.com", "per...@example.com")  # One or many recipients
  subject <- "Email Subject"
  body <- "Email body text"
  smtp <- list(host.name = "smtp.office365.com", port = 587,  # If using Outlook. If not, see the link above for gmail
               user.name = [your email account], 
               passwd = [your password], tls = TRUE)
  files <- c("report.pdf")  # Attach the report you generated above
  send.mail(from = from, to = to, subject = subject, body = body, 
                     smtp = smtp, html = TRUE, authenticate = TRUE, send = TRUE,
                     attach.files = files)
  unlink("report.pdf")  # Can optionally delete the report here when finished

})

Someone else may have a better method, but this is an example that works for me
